Carousel version of the claude-cleans-laptop reel: Claude Code sorts laptop + Google Drive, anything doubtful goes to a 'to be deleted' folder, he deletes by hand. Save slide = the exact prompt (slide 7).
guide: Clean out a slow laptop and a cluttered Google Drive with Claude Code, without deleting anything you can't get back. You need Claude Code, a laptop, and Google Drive for desktop.
1. Install Claude Code from Anthropic and open it in the folder you want sorted, such as Downloads or Documents.
1. Install Google Drive for desktop so your Drive appears as a normal folder Claude Code can read.
1. Ask Claude Code to list what is taking up space and to group files into duplicates, old installers, large files and unused folders.
1. Have it create a folder called "To be deleted" and move anything doubtful into it, rather than deleting.
1. Tell it to tidy the files you are keeping into clearly named folders, on the laptop and in Google Drive.
1. Open the "To be deleted" folder yourself, check what is in it, and delete by hand what you don't need.
1. Restart the laptop and see whether it feels faster before you spend money on a new one.
Watch out: never let Claude Code delete anything itself; moving doubtful files into a "To be deleted" folder keeps every decision with you.

```
You are helping me clean up a slow laptop and my Google Drive. Work only inside <folders to sort, e.g. Downloads and Documents> and my Google Drive for desktop folder at <Drive folder location>.
Do not delete anything. Do not move anything outside those folders.
Steps:
1. List what is using the most space, and find duplicates, old installers, very large files and folders I have not opened in <number> months.
2. Create a folder called "To be deleted" in each location.
3. Move anything doubtful into "To be deleted" instead of removing it. Leave anything you are sure I need where it is.
4. Tidy the files that remain into clearly named folders.
5. Write a plain-English summary of what you moved, how much space it frees, and why each group went into "To be deleted".
I use <Windows or Mac> and <ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code>. Show me the plan and wait for my approval before you move any files. Return the summary as a list I can check before I delete anything by hand.
```
